info.title: Bitnob API v2
info.description:
# Bitnob API v2

A single, ready-to-use collection for the Bitnob Core API v2 — balances, payouts, cards, trading, lightning, bulk transfers and more.

## Quick start

1. Set the collection variables:
   - `base_url` — e.g. `https://api.bitnob.com`
   - `client_id` — your workspace client id
   - `client_secret` — your workspace client secret
2. Run any request. The **collection-level pre-request script** automatically:
   - generates a fresh `timestamp` + `nonce`,
   - canonicalises the JSON body (compact form),
   - computes `HmacSHA256(client_id:timestamp:nonce:body, client_secret)`, and
   - injects `X-Auth-Client`, `X-Auth-Timestamp`, `X-Auth-Nonce`, `X-Auth-Signature`.

You never modify headers manually — just edit the body and hit send.

## Conventions

- **Amounts** are in *base units* (whole integers, no decimals). For USDT that's `1 USDT = 1_000_000` units. For BTC that's sats.
- **`memo`** is only meaningful for chains that require a destination tag (e.g. Stellar). Omit it for Tron/Ethereum.
- **`reference`** is caller-supplied and should be unique per action for safe retries / idempotency.
- Most error responses follow RFC 7807 (`type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `correlation_id`, `timestamp`).

## Folders

Every resource lives in its own folder. Happy-path requests come first, followed by list/filter endpoints, then action endpoints (`confirm`, `retry`, `cancel`, etc.).

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: Authentication probe for verifying workspace credentials.

tags.name: Balances
tags.description: Wallet balances per currency for the authenticated workspace.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: On-chain deposit addresses for receiving crypto.

tags.name: Withdrawals
tags.description: On-chain withdrawals from workspace balance to an external wallet address.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Unified transaction history across all movement types.

tags.name: Exchange rates
tags.description: Point-in-time conversion rates between supported currencies.

tags.name: Trading
tags.description: Spot trading: quotes, orders, scheduled DCA, and target (limit-style) orders.

tags.name: Bulk transfers
tags.description: Batched disbursements from CSV or inline items, with optional recurring schedules.

tags.name: Virtual accounts
tags.description: Dedicated NGN bank account numbers issued against a customer. Deposits credit your NGN balance.

tags.name: Cards
tags.description: Virtual and physical card issuance, funding, controls, and transactions. Amounts are in micro-units of `currency` (1 whole unit = 1,000,000 — e.g. $50.00 on a USD card is `50000000`).

tags.name: Beneficiaries
tags.description: Saved crypto and fiat payout recipients.

tags.name: Payouts
tags.description: Fiat payouts to bank accounts and mobile money across supported countries. Flow: **quote → initialize → finalize**.

BitnobHmacAuth.name: X-Auth-Signature
BitnobHmacAuth.description:
HMAC-SHA256 authentication. All calls must include four headers:
- `X-Auth-Client`   — your workspace client id
- `X-Auth-Timestamp` — Unix seconds
- `X-Auth-Nonce`    — 16-byte random hex
- `X-Auth-Signature` — hex(HMAC-SHA256(
  `{client_id}:{timestamp}:{nonce}:{compact_json_body}`,
  client_secret))

PayoutWebhookEvent.description: Payload delivered to your callback_url when a payout changes state. Switch on `event`; `data.status` is the lower-case event outcome, not the payout record lifecycle status.

event_id.description: Unique id for this delivery. De-duplicate on it, since events may be retried.

quote_id.description: The quote this payout was created from.

company_id.description: The company that owns the payout.

reference.description: Reference for the payout, echoed back for reconciliation.

settlement_amount.description: Amount credited to the beneficiary in to_currency.

fees.description: Fee charged for processing the payout, in from_asset.

payment_reason.description: The payment_reason supplied on initialize, when one was set.

beneficiary.description: Destination the funds settled to. Absent on some events.

bank_code.description: Destination bank or mobile-money provider code.

created_at.description: When the payout record was created.

updated_at.description: When the payout record was last updated.

completed_at.description: When the payout reached a terminal state. Absent while in flight.
